notes.title: [Notice] 09/19 (Fri) Temporary Maintenance [Completed]
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]Maintenance will take place to fix certain issues in the game.[/p][p]We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Check below for more details.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]👑 09/19 (Fri) Temporary Maintenance[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p][b]■ Maintenance Schedule (UTC)[/b][/p][p]- 09/19 (Fri) 06:00 - [strike]07:20[/strike][b] > 07:15 \[Completed][/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]■ Details[/b][/p][p]Fixes the following issue(s):[/p][p]- \[Power Up Dungeon] Issue when using Largertha at Chivalry Tier 2 or above, she would remove Gorgo’s passive skill ‘Protection of Dust’[/p][p]- \[Hero] Issue where, in particular circumstances, the \[Hits Taken ⇄ ATK ▼] effect from Herja’s ‘Fallen Temptation‘ skill is not applied correctly. \[Added on 09/19 (Fri) 03:30 (UTC)]
[/p][p][b]■ Notes[/b][/p][p]* The game will not be available during the maintenance.[/p][p]* Maintenance schedule and content are subject to change.[/p][p]

[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]We will keep doing our best to provide the best game experience.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [Hero Introduction] Herja
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]🌟 Broken-Winged, Herja 🌟[/p][p] [/p][p]The strongest and most ruthless Valkyrie.[/p][p] [/p][p]She was once loyal to Freya and cherished as one of her best warriors. However, her use of excessive violence to quell a human rebellion disappointed Freya, who sympathized with humanity.[/p][p] [/p][p]After a long imprisonment, Herja has been freed, and now seeks revenge on Freya, ushering a new age of the gods.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][u][url="https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/51/3709"]🔗[b] \[Hero Introduction: Herja][/b][/url][/u][/p][p]

notes.title: [Hero Introduction] Lucius
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]🌟Tyrant Emperor, Lucius🌟[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]The Emperor of Rome.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Growing up, he was a foolish prince who lived in the shadows of his older brother and heir to the throne, Cornelius.[/p][p]
[/p][p]However, his brother’s sudden death brought him into the direct line of succession. Unfortunately, the taste of power as emperor was far too sweet, and he became a ruthless tyrant.[/p][p]

notes.title: [Dev. Note #13] 'King Arthur: Legends Rise' Developer’s Note
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ 13th Dev. Note 📜[/p][p]It is time to face stronger enemies and discover new powers![/p][p]
[/p][p]More information on upcoming changes and new equipment are available below.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]■ Hall of Conquerors Update [/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]Challenged by all warriors of Britain, the ‘Hall of Conquerors’ will see new changes soon.[/p][p]Fight as a true conqueror, face ‘stronger opponents’, and discover ‘new rewards’.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The number of Hearts will be expanded from 100 to 150.[/p][p]Experience even more challenging battles and seize a new opportunity to Power Up![/p][p]
[/p][p]Additionally, damage related to element compatibility will be applied to each boss, adding a [/p][p]strategic element where the efficiency of the battle varies based on the element. Use your opponent's weakness to your advantage, and turn the tables during battle![/p][p]
[/p][p]Season Ranking Rewards will be renewed, with the inclusion of ’Lagertha Storm Relic Shards’. Rewards vary based on the final ranking you achieve, so make sure you take this chance and become even stronger![/p][p]

[/p][p][b]■ New Equipment & Equipment Dungeon Expansion [/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]A wider horizon lies ahead, my Liege! The journey in search of powerful equipment continues.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The Equipment Dungeon will have its current 10 floors expanded to 12, and 3 new equipment sets will be added. [/p][p]
[/p][p]The expansion will also bring new equipment with unique effects, allowing a wider variety of team formations and strategies to be created.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Face stronger enemies💥, unleash unique powers with new equipment sets💪, and [/p][p]conquer the battlefield! ✨[/p][p]

[/p][p]* All content in this notice are under development, and are subject to change.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]The implementation date of the content mentioned in this Dev. Note will be announced through a future notice.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Known Issues [Updated on 09/19 (Fri) 07:15 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]We’d like to inform our players of certain issues found in the game.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Check below for more details.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[b]👑 Known Issues[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p][b]■ Known Issues[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]There are no known issues in the game as of now.[/p][p]
[/p][p]* We’ll update this notice once issues are confirmed.[/p][p]

[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]■ Fixed Issues[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 09/18 (Thu) 08:00 (UTC)][/p][p]- \[Power Up Dungeon] Issue when using Largertha at Chivalry Tier 2 or higher, she would remove Gorgo’s passive skill ‘Protection of Dust’[/p][p]- \[Hero] Issue where, in particular circumstances, the \[Hits Taken ⇄ ATK ▼] effect from Herja’s ‘Fallen Temptation‘ skill is not applied correctly. [b](Fixed as of 09/19 07:15 UTC)[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/28 (Thu) 06:00 (UTC)][/p][p]- Issue when updating the game through the Netmarble Launcher (PC), the launcher occasionally freezes at 0% progress. [b](Fixed as of 09/03 03:20 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* This issue may occur while downloading the launcher’s file. The download should complete after waiting for a certain period of time.[/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/27 (Wed) 09:05 (UTC)][/p][p]- \[Knightage Trial of Initiation] Issue where it is not possible to claim ‘Tab Completion Rewards’ occasionally. (Fixed as of 09/17 01:30 UTC)[/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/25 (Mon) 05:25 (UTC)][/p][p]- Issue when purchasing the Daily Stat Change Stone Pack, the purchase count doesn’t accumulate towards the ‘bonus reward upon purchase’ milestones. [b](Fixed as of 08/26 02:00 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* The related package sales will be temporarily suspended in order to fix this issue. We will update this notice once we resume the sales.[/p][p]* The accumulated purchase count will be adjusted at a later date, and once the adjustment is complete, it will be possible to claim the related reward(s).
* Game access may be temporarily restricted during the adjustment in order to protect the player’s game data.[/p][p]
[/p][p]- Issue where ‘Hild’ is not displayed in the list of items in the Memory Rudiment Selection Chest (Legendary).[b](Fixed as of 09/03 03:20 UTC)[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/21 (Thu) 10:15 (UTC)][/p][p]- Issue where the ‘Frame’ from the Arena’s Season Rewards was not distributed. [b](Fixed as of 09/03 03:20 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* The missing frame(s) will be distributed manually at a later date.
* Game access may be temporarily restricted during the reward distribution in order to protect the player’s game data.[/p][p]* The missing ‘Frames’ from the Arena Season 42 Rewards have been distributed as of 08/22 (Fri) 01:20 (UTC).[/p][p]* The missing ‘Frames’ from the Arena Season 43 Rewards have been distributed as of 08/28 (Thu) 02:00 (UTC).[/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/20 (Wed) 02:30 (UTC)][/p][p]- \[Arena] Issue when using the ‘Auto Proceed’ function, all opponent's nicknames are displayed as the nickname of the first opponent. [b](Fixed as of 09/17 01:30 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* The correct nicknames are displayed in the battle results screen[/p][p]
[/p][p]- \[Shard Shop] Issue where regardless of the amount of Memory Stones/Relic Shards you own, 100 units will be displayed in the exchange list. [b](Fixed as of 09/17 01:30 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* The exchange will not proceed if the amount in the exchange list exceeds the amount you actually own.[/p][p]
[/p][p]- \[Shard Shop] Issue where even though making a purchase is not possible due to insufficient Points, the feature to adjust the purchase's quantity is displayed. [b](Fixed as of 09/17 01:30 UTC)[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]- \[Restricted Area] Issue where the information of dungeons other than the one you are currently at is occasionally displayed. [b](Fixed as of 09/17 01:30 UTC)[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/07 (Thu) 09:40 (UTC)][/p][p]- \[Hall of Conquerors] Issue where even though Group Rankings are composed of 500 positions, only 100 are being displayed. [b](Fixed as of 08/20 02:30 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* Please note that the actual rewards are correctly distributed based on group ranking.[/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/06 (Wed) 05:15 (UTC)][/p][p]- Removes players who used unconventional methods to achieve \[Forbidden Dungeon] ranks from the ranking history and retrieves related rewards. [b](Completed as of 08/06 10:10 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* Game access may be temporarily unavailable during the removal process.[/p][p]
[/p][p]\[Added on 08/06 (Wed) 01:10 (UTC)][/p][p]- Issue when achieving Rate Up Relic Summon Mileages, the reward obtention animation is not displayed. [b](Fixed as of 08/20 02:30 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* Please note that upon achieving mileages, the corresponding Relic Shard Points will be reflected directly to the amount you have.[/p][p]

[/p][p]\[Added on 07/25 (Fri) 08:40 (UTC)][/p][p]- \[Hall of Conquerors] Issue where the 'Reward Info' → 'Season Ranking Rewards' displayed rankings based on world ranking instead of group ranking.[b](Fixed as of 08/20 01:10 UTC)[/b][/p][p]* Please note that the actual rewards are correctly distributed based on group ranking.[/p][p]
[/p][p]- \[PvP Content] Issue where buffs/debuffs were occasionally applied in favor of the defending team when both the offense and defense teams included Valla and Lagertha. [b](Fixed as of 08/06 01:10 UTC)[/b][/p][p]

[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p] We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.[/p][p]

notes.title: 07/22 (Tue) Update Details
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]‘King Arthur: Legends Rise Update 🔥[/p][p]A new Rate Up Summon and various events are on the way! 💨[/p][p] [/p][p]Check below for more details![/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p][b]👑 07/22 (Tue) Update Details[/b][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ New Content[/b][/p][p][b](1) Dimensional Rift Season 2: Storm Otherworld[/b][/p][p]The monsters in the Dimensional Rift have changed to Storm Element,[/p][p]and materials to engrave and power up Storm Relics can now be obtained.[/p][p] [/p][p]* Daily Dimensional Purification Rewards for Tiers 1 to 10 have been slightly increased.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b](2) Hall of Conquerors Season 4[/b][/p][p]A new boss ‘Thrym’ will appear in the Hall of Conquerors![/p][p] [/p][p]- Thrym: While it gets stronger by stacking Buffs, it becomes vulnerable to Abnormal Status when preparing a powerful Attack.[/p][p]- Blazing Gorgos: a boss that receives additional damage from Inflict DOT and DOT Explosion effects.[/p][p]- Talos: The existing Talos element will change to Frost.[/p][p] [/p][p]* \[Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards have been updated, changing Caliburn Arhur ‘Frost Relic Shard’ for ‘Storm Relic Shards’.[/p][p]* \[Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards will change periodically.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ New Additions[/b][/p][p][b](1) Hall of Conquerors[/b][/p][p]- A new feature that triggers the destruction of terrain structures based on the number of hearts destroyed has been added.[/p][p](There are a total of 4 Tiers, triggering every 10, 30, 50, and 70 hearts destroyed.)[/p][p]- World Rank has been added.[/p][p]It is now possible to check various players’s Record and Team Formation details.[/p][p] [/p][p]
 [b](2) New Content Notification System[/b][/p][p]A notification feature for new content and/or features has been added to the top menu.[/p][p]You can check what’s new in the game through this menu, with shortcuts available to the corresponding guide page.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43829190/cd0db3a0b1d424bf145d2a7bc9ae5f6f9933fe97.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b](3) Hero Highlights[/b][/p][p]It is now possible to check the Teams and Equipment other users used to clear the content recently. You are also able to save that team’s skill order and settings.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ New Events[/b][/p][p]- New Legendary Hero ‘Valla’ Rate Up Summon[/p][p]* [b]New heroes will only be available through the Rate Up Summon.[/b] It will not be possible to obtain Valla through other Summon Tickets (Legendary Hero Summon Selection Ticket, Legendary Hero Summon Ticket, Rare - Legendary Summon Ticket, Rudiment Summon, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.[/p][p]* [b]New Relics will only be available through the Rate Up Summon.[/b] It will not be possible to obtain the newly released Relics through other Summons (Relic Summons, Relic Summon Tickets, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.[/p][p]- Stamina Consumption Event[/p][p]- Arena Challenge Event[/p][p]- Raid Bounty: Aldri[/p][p]- Event Arena Daily Missions Event[/p][p]- Valla Event Dungeon[/p][p]- Valla Power Up Event[/p][p]- Special Relic Summon Event[/p][p] [/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]🔗 Check out the[url="https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508"] [b]\[Ongoing Events Notice][/b][/url][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]■ New Packages[/b][/p][p]- Valla Rate Up Relic Package[/p][p]- Valla Chivalry Relay Packages[/p][p]- Other 16 New Packages[/p][p] [/p][p]🔗 Check out the [b][u][url="https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/47/3549"]\[New Packages Notice][/url][/u][/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]■ Improvements[/b][/p][p][b](1) Adds Legendary Relic(s) to the list of relics in the Special Relic Summon Banner and to Relic Summoning Items.[/b][/p][p]- \[Lagertha] Shivering Fir[/p][p]* Added the legendary relic to the list of relics available through the Special Relic Summon banner.[/p][p] [/p][p]- \[Revenant Merlin] The Path of No Return[/p][p]* Can be obtained through the Storm Relic Summon, Relic Shard Summon Tickets, and the Shard Shop. The summon rates applied will vary based on the rates at the time you use the item.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p][b](2) Stats/Relic Engraving and Relic Element Enhancement[/b][/p][p]- Increases the ATK / DEF / HP values obtained from Stat and Relic Engraving.[/p][p]- Element Damage increased through Relic Element enhancement will now be increased to 20%, instead of the maximum of 10% previously applied.[/p][p]
[/p][p]* Stats that were already engraved or enhanced will also be increased.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p][b](3) Dismantle Equipment[/b][/p][p]- Increased the chances of obtaining Forged Fragment when dismantling equipment.[/p][p]- Increased the amount of Forged Fragment obtained when dismantling keepsakes and 6★ equipment. (8 → 10)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b](4) Shard Shop (Hero) Reorganization[/b][/p][p]Includes Relic Shard Points, Equipment Engraving Chest, Whetstone Selection Chest, Brooch Selection Chest to the regular sales list. The items are displayed at a set rate.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b](5) Other Improvements[/b][/p][p]- When tapping the Raid Score, details related to that score will be displayed in \[Clan Raid].[/p][p]- Win and Defeat point requirements for Gold 5 to Master 1 have been adjusted to speed up the Rank progression in the \[Arena].[/p][p]- Improves how the details on damage due to element compatibility are displayed in the Elemental Corrosion Tier Selection pop-up window in the \[Dimensional Rift].[/p][p]- Includes details on Element Compatibility to the top of the Hero Info in the Team Selection screen in the \[Dimensional Rift].[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]- \[Dimensional Rift ] Issue where skill information for Caliburn Arthur on Floor 10 of the Flame Otherworld was not displayed correctly.[/p][p]- \[Tutorial] Issue where a phrase was incorrect in the ‘Relics Element Enhancement’ tutorial.[/p][p]- \[Dimensional Rift] Issue where after setting a team and returning from the ‘Hero Management’ screen, the settings revert to the last battle’s team.[/p][p]- \[Skill Order Settings] Issue where the skill order for Relics that were not equipped was displayed.[/p][p]- Issue where the terminology in ‘Debuff Immunity’ details was inconsistent.[/p][p]- Issue when reconnecting during a Tutorial, a ‘Locked Content’ error message is displayed.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ Item & Rates Changes[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]* The published rates are rounded according to the Enforcement Decree of the Game Industry Promotion Act and may not add up to 100%.[/p][p] [/p][p]🔗 Check out the[url="https://guide.netmarble.com/kingarthur"] [u]\[Rate Info Guide][/u][/url] for more details![/p][p]
[/p][p]The appearance list (relic list) and rates of the following have been updated due to the inclusion of Lagertha’s ‘Shivering Fir’. [/p][p] - Special Relic Summon banner[/p][p]
[/p][p]The appearance list (relic list) and rates of the following have been updated due to the inclusion of Revenant Merlin’s ‘The Path of No Return’[/p][p]- Storm Relic Summon banner[/p][p]- Precious Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Uncommon - Legendary)[/p][p]- Mysterious Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Rare - Legendary)[/p][p]- Legendary Storm Relic Shard Summon Ticket[/p][p]- Legendary Relic Shard Summon Ticket[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 06/24 (Tue) Update Details [Updated on 06/25 02:35 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Update! ⚔️💥[/p][p]Various events and new content await, my Liege![/p][p] [/p][p]Check below for more details![/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p][b]👑 06/24 (Tue) Update Details[/b][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ New Content[/b][/p][p][b](1) Relic Engraving & Element Enhancement[/b][/p][p]A Relic’s basic stats (Attack, Defense, and HP) can now be improved through the new ‘Relic Engraving’ system.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can obtain Relic Engraving materials in the new content, ‘Dimensional Rift’.[/p][p] [/p][p]- When engraving stats, if it yields a higher value than the current one, it will replace the lower value.[/p][p]- If the new engraving value is lower or equal to the current one, the higher value remains unchanged.[/p][p] [/p][p]* Clear Main Story \[Hard Mode 6-7] to be able to use Relic Engraving.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]You can enhance your Relic’s Element Compatibility through the ‘Element Enhance’ system.[/p][p]Element Enhancement will consume the corresponding Relic’s Relic Shards.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]* Clear Main Story \[Normal Mode 1-4] to use Element Enhancement.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b](2) Dimensional Rift Season 1: Flame Otherworld[/b][/p][p]Dimensional Rift is an element dungeon divided into ‘Otherworlds’ of specific elements.[/p][p] [/p][p]One Otherworld is composed of 15 Floors, with 2 Stages each.[/p][p]Clear both stages to unlock the next floor.[/p][p] [/p][p]Choose the Elemental Corrosion Tier (Normal, Hard, or Hell) to be applied, and enter the stage. The higher the selected Tier, the higher the damage dealt to monsters due to Element Compatibility. For monsters, damage increases according to the Corrosion Tier, regardless of the element.[/p][p] [/p][p]To purify a stage, you must clear it in ‘Hell’ Tier, and you can’t use the same Hero more than once on the same floor.[/p][p] [/p][p]A different Otherworld will be open every season, and every season is 4-weeks long.[/p][p]The next Otherworld will open once a new season begins.[/p][p] [/p][p]The more purified gates you have, the more (and merrier!) rewards you’ll receive daily.[/p][p]It resets every week, so you can challenge it again frequently.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]* Clear Main Story \[Hard Mode 6-7] to be able to use the Dimensional Rift.[/p][p] [/p][p]🔗 Check out the [b][u][url="https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/50/3424"]\[Dimensional Rift Guide: Overview][/url][/u][/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b](3)  Event  Arena Season 2[/b][/p][p]Season 2 of the Event Area will begin![/p][p] [/p][p]With the new season we have new season heroes, as well as the addition of Equipment Engraving materials to the Arena Shop.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td colspan="3"][p][b]Season Heroes[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="3"][p][b]Lagertha, Hild, Vivian, Caliburn Arthur, Tristan[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="3"][p][b]New Arena Conquerors![/p][p] [/p][p]- Bergelmir: While it gets stronger by stacking Buffs, it becomes vulnerable to Abnormal Status when preparing a powerful Attack.[/p][p]- Steel-flanked Penveid: Uses a Barrier and receives additional damage proportional to the number of attacks.[/p][p]- Talos: The existing Talos element will change to Flame.[/p][p] [/p][p]* \[Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards have been updated, changing Caliburn Arthur ‘Storm Relic Shard’ for ‘Frost Relic Shard’.[/p][p]* \[Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards will change periodically.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ New Additions[/b][/p][p][b](1) Arena ‘Retry’[/b][/p][p]A new ‘Retry’ feature has been added to the Arena, allowing you to challenge the same opponent again after being defeated within a set number of attempts.[/p][p]If you win after attempting a ‘retry’, you will recover the points you lost for being defeated, and earn the corresponding points for the victory.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p][b](2) Package Shop Tags[/b][/p][p]A # Tag feature will be added to the Special Offers tab to help find Packages containing the items you are looking for quickly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43829190/40918785396d3c4395343daa840784dfb81c3af4.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b](3) Equipment[/b][/p][p]① Adds the ‘Dismantle All’ function to the results screen of the Repeat Battle.[/p][p]② Adds the ‘Dismantle’ feature to the Equipment menu.[/p][p]③ Adds a feature that allows equipping all equipment from another Hero at once.[/p][p]- In the ‘Detailed Equip Settings’, it is possible to temporarily equip individual equipment or all equipment from another Hero and check how the stats change. Selecting ‘Change’ will then equip them.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ New Events[/b][/p][p]- New Legendary Hero ‘Lagertha’ Rate Up Summon[/p][p]* [b]New heroes will only be available through the Rate Up Summon.[/b] It will not be possible to obtain Lagertha through other Summon Tickets (Legendary Hero Summon Selection Ticket, Legendary Hero Summon Ticket, Rare - [/p][p][b](2) Shard Shop (Relics) Reorganization[/b][/p][p]Due to the new Relic Element Enhancement system, the regular relics will be added again to the shop.[/p][p]Improvements will be made so that only Legendary Relic shards appear in the Weekly Sales list.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p][b](3) Arena[/b][/p][p]- Improves the battle system so that there is no time restriction or Vigor reduction during your attack turn, instead of the Vigor reduction every 30 seconds as before.[/p][p]- Changes the Attack Gauge charging system so that it charges instantly on the hero’s turn, instead of gradually charging as before.[/p][p] [/p][p]* Improvements will follow the Clan War way.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p][b](4) Equipment Preset Pop-up Improvements[/b][/p][p]- Improves the Equipment Preset Settings pop-up so that once you select an equipment, it shows the item’s details.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p][b](5) Other Improvements[/b][/p][p]- \[Battle] Improves the Buff/Debuff icon display, allowing up to 5 icons on the same line (changing the display settings will allow displaying up to 45 icons).[/p][p]- \[Forbidden Dungeon] Improves the Auto Clear function so that it is automatically set to the max. number of clears possible by default.[/p][p]- \[Clan War] Improves usability by making it possible to access the hero management and general top menu directly from the Enemy's Field.[/p][p]- \[[strike]Clan War[/strike] / Clan Raid / Hall of Conquerors] Improves the battle results so that if you leave the battle in the middle, the result will be a Defeat.[/p][p]* The improvement will be applied to Clan War at a later date.[/p][p]- \[Arena / Event Arena / Clan War] Improves the Team Formation Screen so that you can access the Hero Management screen by long-pressing the hero’s icon.[/p][p]- \[Inventory] Increases the max. slots you can expand the inventory to from 1,500 to 2,000 items.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]- \[Battle] Issue where Barrier and Shield were not being reduced if under Escort or Share Damage effects.[/p][p]- \[Battle] Issue where the turns limit in the Battle Bonus conditions and the actual number of turns did not match.[/p][p]- \[Event Arena] Issue where skill links were not working in the special buff details from the enhancement buff information window.[/p][p]- \[Forbidden Dungeon] Issue where the conditions were incorrectly checked when challenging the next floor automatically in Hard Mode.[/p][p]- \[Knight Training Camp] Intermediate Tier 6 Issue where the turns of heroes with AoE skills were skipped when Jack used Stealth.[/p][p]- Issue where the Forbidden Dungeon was included in the Source List of Simple Catalysts.[/p][p]
[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b](5) Item & Rates Changes[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]* The published rates are rounded according to the Enforcement Decree of the Game Industry Promotion Act and may not add up to 100%.[/p][p] [/p][p]🔗 Check out the[url="https://guide.netmarble.com/kingarthur"] [u]\[Rate Info Guide][/u][/url]for more details![/p][p] [/p][p]The appearance list (relic list) and rates of the following have been updated due to the inclusion of Caliburn Arthur’s flame relic ‘Forged Revenge’:[/p][p] [/p][p]- Special Relic Summon banner.[/p][p]- Flame Relic Summon banner.[/p][p]- Precious Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Uncommon - Legendary).[/p][p]- Mysterious Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Rare - Legendary).[/p][p]- Legendary Flame Relic Shard Summon Ticket.[/p][p]- Legendary Relic Shard Summon Ticket.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]

notes.title: [Dev. Note #12] Make Relics Even Stronger! 🔥 New Feature Preview
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ 12th Dev. Note 📜[/p][p]
[/p][p]A new feature to make Relics even stronger❕[/p][p]Find out more about Relic Element Enhancement and Engraving below![/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]■ New Feature: Relic Element Enhancement & Relic Engraving[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]With the new ‘Element Enhancement’ feature, it is possible to enhance the element on each relic up to 10% 🔥[/p][p]
[/p][p]Relic Shards are required to enhance a relic.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43829190/37b28d4f222fff2f0b71fc4a2b9671ba1f444b07.jpg"][/img][/p][p]


[/p][p]Here’s a little secret!! Remember the new content we introduced last time?[/p][p]Through the Daily Dimensional Purification Rewards and Relic Shard Points you can obtain from the ‘Dimensional Rift’, you will be able to engrave relics! 👀[/p][p]
[/p][p]‘Relic Engraving’ is a system to make relics even stronger, as it will grant additional stat(s) to the relics you own.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Exchange the Relics you don’t use for Relic Shard Points, purify dimensions in the Dimensional Rift, and collect the materials needed for relic engraving 💖[/p][p]
[/p][p]Don’t miss this chance to make relics much stronger! ✨[/p][p]

[/p][p]* The content and images in this notice are under development, and are subject to change.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]

[/p][p]Thank you[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [Dev. Note #11] New Content: Dimensional Rift Preview
notes.notes:
[p][b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain![/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ 11th Dev. Note 📜[/p][p]
[/p][p]Here’s a sneak peek on the upcoming ‘Dimensional Rift’ ❕[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]■ New Content: Dimensional Rift[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]A content focused on the hero’s Element ❕[/p][p]
[/p][p]The new content, Dimensional Rift, is divided into Flame, Frost, and Storm element “Otherworlds”. Each floor of the Otherworlds has 2 stages, so you [b]must prepare 2 Teams [/b]to take on the challenge![/p][p]
[/p][p]Each season of the Dimensional Rift is 4 weeks-long, and after a season ends, a new season, with a different Otherworld element will begin.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43829190/8c0068b3d3bbb207a902837a208446a8bd969567.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]Dimensional Rift’s “Elemental Corrosion Tier” is divided into 3 tiers: Normal, Hard, and Hell.[/p][p]The “Elemental Corrosion Tier” changes the damage from element compatibility: the higher the tier you select, the higher is the damage change. However, for monsters, damage increases equally regardless of the elemental compatibility. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Purify corrupted dimensions to earn Daily Dimension Purification Rewards with increasingly better rewards as you purify higher floors 🎁[/p][p]
[/p][p]The [b]rewards [/b]from the Dimensional Rift will certainly play a [b]key [/b]part in your journey![/p][p]We hope you look forward to our new content 💝[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 05/27 (Tue) Update Details [Updated on 06/05 07:10 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]
 
‘King Arthur: Legends Rise Update 🔥
Everything you need to know about the new content and events will be available below.
 
Check below for more details!
 
 
[h1]👑 05/27 (Tue) Update Details[/h1]
 
 
[b]■ New Content[/b]
(1) Event Arena
A new arena has been added to the Colosseum! In the Event Arena, you can enjoy fierce battles with various buffs and seasonal heroes.
 
For a period of 2 weeks, you will be able to challenge the ‘King Arthur’s Legendary 200’, chosen based on the Arena tier from the previous week.
 
Starting from the no. 200, a list of 4 players is displayed, and you can challenge them using Arena Tickets. If you win, Honor Tokens will be distributed based on your opponent’s rank.
Defeating a high-ranked player in one go will also earn you the rewards for the rank below.

 
① Season Buff
- Core buffs applied during the Season.

② Enhanced Heroes
- Heroes who will receive exclusive stats increase buffs if included in the Event Arena team.

③ Enhancement Buffs (Purchasable)
- Available on a daily basis, these buffs can be purchased, and are maintained until the end of the season.
- 5 common buffs + 1 special buff will be available daily, and you can choose 4 of them to purchase.
- Purchased buffs are cumulative, and special buffs are skill-based and disappear when you win the battle.
 
* Clear Main Story [Normal Mode 5-7] to be able to enter the Event Arena.
* Arena Tickets are recharged daily at 00:00 (UTC) to the max. amount one can own.
                                                 	
 
(2)  Equipment Engraving System
A new ‘Equipment Engraving’ system will be added, allowing additional stats to be granted to equipment. It is now possible to enhance your equipment even further!
 
- You can add 2 types of stats: basic and special stats.
- When engraving, both stats and values change at the same time according to set rates, and it is not possible to change only one of them.
- Materials required to engrave can be obtained by dismantling equipment.
 
* The stats and values vary based on the equipment part.
* Clear Main Story [Normal 4-7] to use Equipment Engraving.
 

(3) Dismantle Equipment System
A ‘Dismantle Equipment’ system will be added. The materials required to engrave equipment can be obtained through this system.
 
You can obtain 3 engraving materials and gold at set rates.
 
- Forged Fragment: basic engraving material
- Transformed Residue: material consumed when engraving ‘basic stats’
- Recovered Essence: material consumed when engraving ‘special stats’

* Clear Main Story [Normal 4-7] to use Equipment Dismantling.
 

(4) Hall of Conquerors Season 2
New bosses will appear in the Hall of Conquerors.
 
- Blazing Gorgos: a boss that receives additional damage from Inflict DOT and DOT Explosion effects.
- Ciaran: inflict debuffs on Ciaran to increase the damage dealt by your allies.
- Talos: the existing Talos element will change to Storm.

 * [Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards have been updated, changing Caliburn Arhur ‘Frost Relic Shards’ for ‘Storm Relic Shards’. [b][Added on 06/05 07:10 (UTC)][/b]
* [Hall of Conquerors] Season Ranking Rewards will change periodically. [b][Added on 06/05 07:10 (UTC)][/b]

[b]■ New Additions[/b]
- [Clan] New feature to send clan invitations via chat to promote the clan and encourage member recruitment.
- [Clan War] New option to include members who have not been in the clan for at least 24h to be eligible to participate in the war in the War Request conditions  (The member will be displayed in the member’s list).
- [Clan War] New War Team preset settings.
- [Inventory] New function to bulk open probability/chance based chests.
- [UI] New ‘Auto Challenge Next Stage’ will be added to stage breakthrough-type content.
 
 
[b]■ New Events[/b]
-  New   Legendary   Hero  ‘ Hild ’  Rate Up Summon.
* New heroes will only be available through the Rate Up Summon. It will not be possible to obtain Charlotte through other Summon Tickets (Legendary Hero Summon Selection Ticket, Legendary Hero Summon Ticket, Rare - Legendary Summon Ticket, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
* New Relics will only be available through the Rate Up Summon. It will not be possible to obtain the newly released Relics through other Summons (Relic Summons, Relic Summon Tickets, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
- 0.5-Year Anniversary Event 1
- 0.5-Year Anniversary Event 2
- Stamina Consumption Event
- Arena Challenge Event
- Event Arena Daily Missions Event
- Raid Bounty:  Tarrasque
- New/Returning Player Check-in Event
- New/Returning Player Mission Event
- Conquest: Hild
- Hild Mission Event
- Hild Event Dungeon
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508][b]🔗 Check out the [Event Notice][/b][/url]
 
 
[b]■ New Packages[/b]
- 30 New Packages
- 3 New Packages exclusive for New Players.
- 3 New Packages exclusive for Returning Players.
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/47/3295][b]🔗 Check out the [New Packages Notice][/b][/url]
 
 
[b]■ Improvements[/b]
 
(1) Mission Rewards Improvements
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/fa9605a40237f93dd31b2a45fbbdad211267c403.png[/img]

 
(2) Power Up Dungeon
- [Equipment Dungeon] Removes 4★ equipment from Floor 10 on each Equipment Dungeon, and increases the appearance rates of 5-6★ equipment.
- [Power Up Dungeon] Reduces the difficulty of Floors 7 to 9 of each dungeon. (Excluding Burning Land)
- [Power Up Dungeon] Adds Gorgos Passive Skill
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/6e3694782d73efcb00943e94e2d082b7faf6ca4a.png[/img]
* The information above considers the Boss info values in Burning Land 7.
 
(3) Forbidden Dgn Hard Ach. Pack
- Adjusts the achievement conditions from Floor 60 to Floor 50, and Floor 50 to Floor 45.
 
(4) Event / Special Shops
- Unifies how the rarity of items is displayed in their name. (The rarity will be displayed before the item’s name without brackets)
- Adds colors to the name of items available for purchase to improve the visualization of the rarity.
- Probability-based items of Rare - Legendary grade will use the prefix ‘Mysterious’ and colors will be applied to represent their grades.
- Improves how rarity is displayed for icons of Statue items.
- Improves the Special Shop tab menu so it won’t disappear even if you scroll down/up.
 
(4) Other Improvements
- [Tutorial] Simplified the paths of some tutorials.
- [Favor Dungeon] Improves the dungeon, allowing all Favor Dungeons to be open at all times.
- [Main Story] Changes element of the star achievement condition from opposite element to normal element.
- [Battle] Expands the Battle Multiplier to x4, x5.
- [UI] When time displayed in the Source List exceeds one day, it will show the number of days.
- [UI] Improves the location of the pop-up so it won’t overlap with the Tooltip UI when tapping the Relic icon.
- [Account] Increases the max. amount of Stamina for each account level.
- When leveling up, the maximum amount of Stamina will be granted.
 

[b]■ Bug Fixes[/b]
 
[Hero]
- Issue where the buff icon was not displayed when Gawain gained the ‘Guardian of May’ buff during battle.
- Issue where if a monster dies while Tristan still has an extra turn left, it is not possible to proceed with the battle.
- Issue where Baudwin’s ‘Share Damage’ was not applied correctly.
- Issue where Nika’s Storm Relic Active Skill 3 would apply [Attack Speed Increase I].
 
 
[UI]
- Issue where the description text in the item exchange pop-up would go over the pop-up area.
- Adjusts the size of texts for some buttons in English so that they fit the button.
- Issue where events were not displayed again if you close the mini banner in the Lobby screen.
- Issue where the buff description of enemies with long names would go over the info pop-up limits.
- Issue when selecting certain options in the Equipment filter, both the filter option and the equipment filter pop-ups would close.
 
[Other Bug Fixes]
- [Battle] Issue where occasionally the Harpies on Podarge’s Sanctuary would not be displayed.
- [Battle] Issue where after using a skill, closing the game while in battle, and reconnecting the game, the battle time would freeze, reducing clear time.
- [Clan] Issue when accepting a Clan invitation, the button would not be deactivated immediately.
- [Clan War] Issue where the War Schedule was displayed incorrectly in the season registration pop-up window.
- [Hall of Conquerors] Issue where the regular attack damage font was displayed even when a critical hit was triggered when attacking the Steel-flanked Penveid.
- [Clan Raid] Issue where the UI of the Restricted Area’s ticket information would disappear after the Raid’s ranking pop-up.
- [Shop] Issue where the selection icon was not displayed in the image and purchase pop-up of certain selection chests on sale.
- [Item] Issue when using selection chests, the order of the ‘owned’ and ‘max’ amount was displayed incorrectly.
- [Mail] Issue when the Inventory was full and there were items in the Mail to be claimed, the ‘No mail to Read & Claim All’message would be displayed.
- [Test Skills Mode] Issue where the game would crash when trying to use the ‘Skill Order Settings’.
 
 
[b]✨ A special gift to show our gratitude has arrived! ✨[/b]
Coupon Code (‘Special Summon Ticket x10’): KALR05GIFT
 
* The coupon above expires on 06/30 (Mon) 23:59 (UTC).
 
 
Thank you.

- Issue when entering another battle after going through the ‘Sell All’ screen from the Repeat Battle result screen, the new battle’s result screen displays the results from the previous battle.
- Issue where the hero’s Combat Power if displayed doubled in Clan War.
- Issue where the equipment preset information changes to preset 1 when running Repeat Battles.

- Issue where the game freezes when trying to ‘Sell Item” in dungeons without equipment as rewards (ex. Power Up Dungeon).

* The maintenance schedule and details may be subject to change.
* The game will not be available during the maintenance.
* A game build update will take place after the maintenance.


Thank you.

notes.title: 04/28 (Tue) Update Details [Updated on 08:50 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]
 
‘King Arthur: Legends Rise Update 🔥
 
This update will reveal the new content and new legendary hero hinted at in the Scout Report!
 
Various events have also been prepared! Check below for more details💨
 

[h1]👑 04/28 (Tue) Update Details[/h1]
 
 
[b]■ New Content[/b]
(1) Hall of Conquerors
A new content, ‘Hall of Conquerors’, has been added to the Restricted Area.
It consists of 3 dungeons, and the dungeon composition changes every Season.
 
You can earn various rewards, including ‘Memory Rudiment’, and their distribution depends on the highest damage record achieved within a limited number of turns.
Compete with other players for the best record of the season and earn additional rewards based on your position.
 
[b]* The ‘Hall of Conquerors’ will open on 04/30 (Wed) 00:00 (UTC). You must clear Main Story [Hard Mode 3-7] to unlock this content.[/b]
* Each hero has a specific ‘Memory Rudiment’, and you can summon that hero once a certain amount of the new item.
* Daily Missions and Achievements related to the Hall of Conquerors will be added to the game.
 
[b][url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/50/2969]🔗 Check out the [[CM Tips] Hall of Conquerors][/url][/b]
 
(2) New Hero Power Up Content ‘Level Breakthrough’
A new system has been added to allow the expansion of a Hero’s Max Level.
 
The Breakthrough Level increases based on each Tier of the Chivalry Oaths, 1 Level per Tier. In total, the Max Level of a Hero can be expanded up to Lv.70 (considering Chivalry Tier 10).
 
Once you level up a hero to Lv.60, a ‘Breakthrough’ button will replace the ‘Power Up’ button in the Hero Management screen.
The criteria to Breakthrough will be displayed in the Power Up screen of heroes that can go through breakthrough.
 
[b]* Clear Main Story [Hard Mode 5-7] to be able to use Breakthrough.[/b]
* Royal Road ‘Path of Transcendence’ will be added for breakthrough level achievements.
 
(3) Special Summon ‘Wishlist’ System
Select 4 heroes, and once reach a guaranteed summon you will have a chance of 1/4 to summon one of them.
Once you add heroes to your Wishlist, the remaining Legendary heroes not included in it will not be summoned in regular or guaranteed summons.
 
If you don’t add any heroes to it, the current rules for the Special Summon will be applied when summoning.
 
(4) Rate Up Summon Mileage Reward System
- x20 Reward: Legendary Talisman Selection Chest x5
- x45 Reward: Legendary Tome Selection Chest x5
- x70 Reward: Legendary Talisman Selection Chest x10
- x100 Reward: Legendary Tome Selection Chest x10
 

[b]■ New Additions[/b][/b]
- [Clan War] Lord Notice Function
- [Clan War] Enhance Foothold Function (when enhancing a Foothold, Contribution will be earned, and a chat notification will be sent)
- [Equipment] ‘Sell Items’ Function Addition to the Repeat Battle Results Screen
 

 
[b]■ New Events[/b]
[b][Events that start after the 04/28 (Mon) Maintenance][/b]
① New Legendary Hero ‘Caliburn Arthur’ Rate Up Summon
[b]* New heroes will only be available through the Rate Up Summon.[/b] It will not be possible to obtain Charlotte through other Summon Tickets (Legendary Hero Summon Selection Ticket, Legendary Hero Summon Ticket, Rare - Legendary Summon Ticket, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
[b]* New Relics will only be available through the Rate Up Summon.[/b] It will not be possible to obtain the newly released Relics through other Summons (Relic Summons, Relic Summon Tickets, etc.) We will announce when they are added to other summons through either a notice or the description of the in-game items.
② Caliburn Arthur Event Dungeon
③ Stamina Consumption Event
④ Arena Challenge Event
⑤ Raid Bounty: Gorgos
 
[b][Events that start on 04/30 (Wed) 01:00][/b]
① Conquest: Caliburn Arthur
② Hall of Conquerors: Hrungnir Conquest Event
③ Hall of Conquerors: Talos Conquest Event 
 
[b][url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508]🔗 Check out the [Ongoing Events Notice][/url][/b]
 
 
[b]■ Improvements[/b]
 
- Skill Order Settings ‘Detailed Settings’ System
When running Auto-Battle, you can now set up to 5 Skills for heroes to use in specific order, instead of a priority-based setting.
* This version of the Skill Settings has a button at the bottom right corner of the settings screen where you can change between Quick Settings and Detailed Settings.

 
- [Power Up Dungeon] Burning Land Stamina Requirements Reduction
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/b72279d5be8b5c369700bb75959aa80334279003.png[/img]

 
- [Special Shop] Item Removal
① Arena Shop
· Uncommon EXP Potion
· Uncommon Mana Orb
· Uncommon Star Seed
· Uncommon Talisman Chest
· Uncommon Tome Chest

② Clan Shop
· Statue Chest (Uncommon)
· Awakening Stone Chest (Uncommon)

③ Clan War Shop
· Mythic Moonlight Lakestone
· Frost Relic Summon Ticket
· Flame Relic Summon Ticket

④ Forbidden Dungeon Shop
· Set Equipment Crafting Material Selection Chest (Legendary)
· Set Equipment Crafting Material Selection Chest (Mythic)
· Equipment Crafting Support Selection Chest
· Statue Chest (Rare)
· Statue Chest (Legendary)
· Awakening Stone Chest (Rare)
· Awakening Stone Chest (Legendary)
· Simple Catalyst
 
 
- Shard Shop Stock List Renewal
Rate Up Summon Ticket, Legendary Master Memory Stone, and each element’s Relic Summon Ticket will be added to the Shard Shop.
Additionally, Common Grade Hero’s Memory Stones, and each hero’s default element Relics (acquired upon summoning heroes) will not appear.
 
 
- Clan War
① Allow going back to the Ally’s Field after using the replay function.
② Makes leaving a Clan, and expelling Clan members possible during the Calculation Period.
 
 
- [Forbidden Dungeon]
① A [Clear Highest Record] button will be added so that you clear the highest level you achieved even if you select a Floor you have not cleared yet.
② Shows the number of Forbidden Dungeon Tickets owned from outside the dungeon.

 
 
- Equipment Dungeon:
‘Shattered Shield of Belgor’ will be added to Nest of Yskalhaig, and ‘Moonlight Lakestone’ to Origin of Apolleia’s rewards. (Vigor and Counterattack Equipment Crafting Materials)
* Legendary materials can be obtained from levels 5 to 8, and Mythic and/or from 9 and 10 in each dungeon.
‘Shattered Shield of Belgor’ and ‘Moonlight Lakestone’ will be removed from the Main Story.
 
 
- Other Improvements
- [Clan] New feature added to view the previous day’s Member activity history.
- [Equipment] Even if you change the equipment preset in the ‘Hero Management’ screen, the change it will not influence the other content anymore. 
- [Account] Expands the Account Max Level to Lv.150 and the Account Combat Power Achievement Rewards to Tier 40.
- [Alchemy] Increases the crafting limit of Genesis Stone and Horn of Ascension from 1 time to 5 times.

- [Battle Info] - [Permanent Effects tab] will also display all Leader Effects currently applied.
- [Arena] Matching will refresh if among the matched opponents there is information on a player that forfeit battle.
- [Estate] Prevents overlap between the ‘Collect Resources’  button and the ‘Building Upgrade’.
 
 
[b]■ Bug Fixes[/b]
 
[Battle]

- [Hero Management] Issue when leaving the ‘Detailed Equip’ mode and re-entering the Hero Management screen, the Hero list is not displayed.
 
 
[Clan War]

notes.title: [Dev. Note #7] 'King Arthur: Legends Rise' Developer’s Note
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]

‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ 7th Dev. Note 📜

Many have shown great interest in the new content revealed by the Roadmap!

But we believe that there are many other things our players must be curious about besides the Roadmap content. To help satisfy some of that curiosity, we are here today to bring more information on the improvements we are currently working on.

Check below for more details.

[h1]■ Usability & General Improvements[/h1]

[b]① Changes how Stamina accumulates when leveling up[/b]
Many of our players mentioned how inconvenient it is that when you level up while having your Stamina full, the new and old amount of Stamina don’t accumulate.
The King Arthur team acknowledges this inconvenience, and improvements are on the way to allow you to accumulate Stamina once you level up, even if you already had the Stamina maximized.

[b]② Background Auto Battle Feature[/b]
The addition of a new background auto battle feature that allows you to run battles in the background while playing other content is being discussed internally. Once the new feature is added, the plan is to enable content such as Arena and Clan War while running Restricted Area and Story Mode battles automatically in the background. More details on this feature will be provided through a separate notice once everything is confirmed.

[b]③ Battle Multiplier Expansion[/b]
The current Battle Multiplier’s maximum is set at x3, and that limit will be expanded to x5.

[b]④ Favor Dungeon’s Daily Rotation System Removal[/b]
We receive feedback mentioning how hard it was to power up with only one Favor Dungeon opening each day of the week. We took that feedback into consideration and we are preparing to remove the daily rotation system in place since Launch, and make all Favor Dungeons open at all times.

[b]⑤ Equipment Dungeon Rewards Adjustment[/b]
We plan to adjust the rewards of the equipment dungeon so that you can receive equipment of better grade based on the dungeon’s difficulty level. 

[b]⑥ Power Up Dungeon Boss Difficulty Adjustments[/b]
Reducing the difficulty of Power Dungeon Bosses Penveid, Aldri, and Tarrasque is currently under consideration. More details will be provided through a separate notice once everything is confirmed.

[b]⑦ New Arena Rematch Feature[/b]
A ‘rematch’ feature will be added to situations where you are defeated in the Arena.
Using this new feature, if you achieve victory upon trying again, you will receive the points deducted from the previous duel. 

[b]⑧ Clan War Team Setting Improvements[/b]
The Defense Unit set up in Clan War will be improved so that once you set up a Defense Unit once, you are able to keep it until the end of the Clan War.


This Dev. Note brought more details on the improvements that awaits everyone in ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’❕ We hope you enjoy your journey!

The implementation date of the improvements mentioned in this Dev. Note will be announced through a future notice. Thank you for your patience ✨

Thank you.

notes.title: 03/18 (Tue) Update Details [Updated on 03/19 01:10 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]
 
‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Update 🔥
From Legendary Hero’s Rate Up Summon all the way to new events, everything you need to know about the update is available below! 💨
 
Check below for more details!
 
 
[h1]👑 03/18 (Tue) Update Details[/h1]
 
 
[b]■ New Additions[/b]
- [Chat] New features: 1:1 Chat during battle and pin Chat
- [Forge] When crafting Keepsakes, add a Hero List to show which heroes can equip that keepsake.
- Weekly/Monthly Packages renewal.
 
 
[b]■ New Events[/b]
ⓛ Legendary Heroes ‘‘Aine’ & ‘Claudas’ Rate Up Summon
② Aine Mission Event
③ Claudas Mission Event
④ Stamina Consumption Event
⑤ Clan Activities Event
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508][b]🔗 Check out the [Event Notice][/b][/url]
 
 
[b]■ Improvements[/b]
[b]- Special Summon’s Legendary Hero List Update[/b]
- Adds the Legendary Hero ‘Ceres’ to the list of heroes in the Special Summon banner.
 * After the 03/18 (Tue) Update is complete, ‘Ceres’ and ‘Ceres Relics’ can be obtained through Special Summon, Relic Summons (Flame, Frost, Storm), Legendary Hero Summon Tickets (Summon Selection Ticket), Mysterious Hero Summon Ticket, Legendary Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Summon Selection Ticket), Precious Relic Shard Summon Ticket, and Mysterious Relic Shard Summon Ticket. The summon rates applied will vary based on the rates at the time you use the item.
 

[b]- Clan War Improvements[/b]
① The Lord and Clan Senate can make requests to occupy specific Footholds using the [1:1 Request] button during the War Preparation period.
② The [Clan] icon effect of the Estate will change based on the Clan War period.
③ A Team deployment function will be added so that in the event heroes are not deployed to a Foothold, a temporary Team will be automatically deployed instead.
④ Improves the acquisition of win/defeat points based on the Clan War Tier grade.
⑤ Adjusts the period of events related to the Clan War, so that the event starts at the same time as Clan-related content resets.
⑥ General convenience improvements.
 

[b]- Rate Up Heroes ‘Aine’ & ‘Claudas’ Balance Adjustments[/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/bcaaad878bb8c43037a501b9f2d2b9332db72f5a.png[/img]


[b]- Portrait Frame Improvements[/b]
① [Trophy] Improves the player’s Profile Info
② [Arena] Adds frames to Season Rewards
③ [Clan War] Adds frames to League Rewards
④ [Forbidden Dungeon] Adds frames to World Rank Rewards (Hard/Normal Mode)
⑤ [Clan War] Improves the Portrait’s UI

 
[b]- Other Improvements[/b]
① Fixes certain UI/UX that are displayed unnaturally.
② Improves the red dot notifications.
③ [Equipment] Improves the Equipment bulk selling filter.
④ [Inventory] Improves the Inventory categories.
⑤ [Equipment] Adds the equipment stat description to the stat info.
⑥ [Shard Shop]  Improves the display of the maximum quantity that can be exchanged at once in the Shard Shop.
⑦ [Hero] Improves the skill effect displayed when using Aine’s active skill 3.
⑧ [Hero] Improves the display of the Vigor charged while under Amplification effect.
 

[b]■ Bug Fixes[/b]
 
[b][Battle][/b]
- Fixes the issue where chance of triggering the Passive Skill 2 of the ‘Druid Warrior’ monster on Floor 58 of the Forbidden Dungeon is not 100%
- Fixes the issue where the text is not displayed when a hero makes a Co-op Attack.
- Fixes the issue where the hero on the far right side is hidden by the skill selection icon during Cernunnos Wave 2 battle.
- Fixes the issue where the description of Caliburn Arthur’s Passive Skill 1 is displayed incorrectly in Forbidden Dungeon Floor 49.
- Fixes the issue where the text of Yskalhaig’s target parts don’t match the actual parts in the Equipment Dungeon.
 
[b][Hero][/b]
- Fixes the issue where Aine’s Frost Relic Active Skill 3 causes Ceres’ Leader Effect to attack allies.
- Fixes the issue where Gillien’s Passive Skill ‘Harvest Energy’ is not able to remove Rience’s ‘Brainwash’ in Forbidden Dungeon Floor 35.
 
[b][Trophy][/b]
- Fixes the issue when clicking the ‘Favor Dungeon’ shortcut on the Trophies screen, you are redirected to the right screen only after the main Favor Dungeon screen is briefly displayed.
- Fixes the issue when using the ‘go to/back’ shortcuts, only the Favor Dungeon doesn’t redirect you to the Trophy screen immediately.
 
[b][Clan War][/b]
- Fixes the issue where after claiming the rewards at the end of the Clan War, the red dot notification is not applied, and is not removed after claiming the rewards from the mail.
- Fixes the issue where it looks like you receive Glory Tokens when watching the Replay.
 
[b][Arena][/b]
- Fixes the issue where after reentering the Hero Management after changing your Team formation, the Team returns to the previous formation when moving to the Estate.
- Fixes the issue where the Tier (number) is displayed in front of the Grade’s name in the result screen.
 
[b][Other Bug Fixes][/b]
- [Missions] Fixes the issue where all missions of a Daily Mission series appear to be open on Day 1.
- [Main Story] Fixes the issue when defeating the chapter’s Boss, the ‘kill’ text is not displayed.
- [Main Story] Fixes the issue where the light doesn’t disappear when trying to organize the mirror pieces in Chapter 7.
- [Portrait] Fixes the issue where images are not displayed during the event dialogue in Adventure Chapter 10.
Fixes the issue when playing the game in Japanese, the Floor’s number in the main screen of the ‘Forbidden Dungeon’ is displayed in a small size.
- [Shop] Fixes the issue where the purchase period of the Relay Package was displayed incorrectly in the pack’s image.
- [Event] Fixes the issue when selecting a tab, the selection area is displayed redundantly.
- [Codex] Fixes the issue where Ralph’s Adventure tags 3 and 4 are not displayed in the codex.
- [Codex] Fixes the issue where Aine’s Adventure tag 4 is not displayed in the codex.
- [Steam] Fixes the issue where your friend’s status info is not displayed when playing Equipment Dungeon ‘Podarge's Sanctuary’.
- [Forbidden Dungeon]  Fixes the issue where monsters with ‘debuff’ removal skills would remove all effects, including ‘Abnormal Status’.
- Fixes the issue where the Buff/Debuff expansion/reduction button was not working properly after the 02/18 (Tue) Update.
- Fixes the issue where scrolling was not possible when checking the items obtained after a Repeat Battle.
 
 
[b]■ Item & Rates Changes[/b]
 
* The published rates are rounded according to the Enforcement Decree of the Game Industry Promotion Act and may not add up to 100%.

Check out the following for more details!
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/49/2598][b]🔗 [Update Details Notice][/b][/url]
[url=https://guide.netmarble.com/kingarthur][b]🔗 [Rate Info Guide][/b][/url]
 
 
Thank you.

notes.title: 100-Day Celebration Event - Discord Emoji Reaction💯 Event
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]
 
King Arthur: Legends Rise 100th day anniversary is coming soon! 
 
We’d like to thank everyone for their love and support, and the King Arthur team will keep doing their best to improve. 
 
As a part of our preparations, we will hold a [b]100th Day Anniversary Event🎁[/b] 
 
Celebrate <King Arthur: Legends Rise> upcoming anniversary with us by reacting to our post on Discord!
 
Check below for more details.
 

[h1]👑 100-Day Celebration Event - Discord Emoji Reaction💯 Event[/h1]

 [img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/97ab805acad783e73c0b4d11501a204832785222.png[/img]
 
[b]■ Period (UTC)[/b]
- 03/05 (Wed) After Maintenance - 03/11 (Tue) 23:59
 
 
[b]■ Details[/b]
- ‘React’ (with emojis) to the [100th Day Anniversary Event] post in ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’ Official Discord to participate.
🔗 [b][url=https://discord.com/channels/1022210091350503496/1290933638460080170/1346677890221215744]‘100th Day Anniversary Event’ Post Link[/url][/b]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/d1e78bf9c7693615607aa24421c40e682ebf919a.png[/img]

[b]■ Event Reward[/b]
- Rewards will be distributed based on the total reactions (emojis) achieved by the [100-Day Celebration Event] post at the end of the event. There is a chance to earn up to [b]300 Free Crystals[/b].
 
① Achieving 100 emoji reactions: ‘Free Crystals x100’
② Achieving 200 emoji reactions: ‘Free Crystals x200’
② Achieving 300 emoji reactions: ‘Free Crystals x300’

- 03/14 (Fri)

notes.title: 03/05 (Wed) Maintenance and Patch Details [Updated on 03/07 06:30 (UTC)]
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]


A patch and maintenance have been scheduled for 03/05 (Wed).
 
Check below for more details!
 

 
[h1]👑 03/05 (Wed) Maintenance and Patch Details[/h1]
 
 
[b]■ Details[/b]
[b](1) New Events[/b]
- ‘Iweret’ & ‘Clarisin’ Rate Up Summon
- Iweret Mission Event
- Clarisin Mission Event
- King Arthur 100-Day Celebration Preparations Event
- Raid Bounty:  Aldri
- Arena Challenge Event
- Gold Collecting Event
 
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/52/508][b]🔗Check out the  [Event Notice][/b][/url]
 
[b](2) Improvements & Changes[/b]
- Adds the Legendary Hero ‘Gilroy’ to the list of heroes in the Special Summon Banner.
* After the 03/05 (Wed) Maintenance is complete, ‘Gilroy’ and ‘Gilroy Relics’ can be obtained through Special Summon, Relic Summons (Flame, Frost, Storm), Legendary Hero Summon Tickets (Summon Selection Ticket), Mysterious Hero Summon Ticket, Legendary Relic Shard Summon Ticket (Summon Selection Ticket), Precious Relic Shard Summon Ticket, and Mysterious Relic Shard Summon Ticket. The summon rates applied will vary based on the rates at the time you use the item.
- It is now guaranteed to obtain the rate up hero from the Rate Up Summon when the Guaranteed Summon countdown reaches 0.
* In the event the rate up hero is obtained before the countdown reaches 0, the summon countdown will reset. In the event a different legendary hero is obtained, the countdown will not reset.
 
 
[b](3) Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixes the issue where the time limit was set to 3 minutes when playing Clan Raid.
- Fixes the issue where Podarge's [Attack Gauge Disruption] effect was not applied correctly in ‘Podarge's Sanctuary’ Equipment Dungeon.
- Fixes the issue where Guinevere’s Chivalry Tier 8 [Damage Dealt Decrease] debuff was applying Positive Effects to the opponent.
- Fixes the issue where after Nika is revived and returns to battle, the HP bar would not change after recovering heroes due to her Passive Skill 2.
- Fixes the issue when playing Forbidden Dungeon in Hard Mode, the turns of the opponent’s [Romantic Reversal] were not decreased when Guinevere was hit.
 
 
[b](4) Known Issues[/b]
- Issue where Isolde’s Passive Skill 1 is not applied to allies, and is only applied to herself.
- Issue where the remaining time to purchase the 100 Day Celebration Relay Package displayed in the banner is different from the one in the package’s image.
* The ‘7d’ displayed in the package’s image is incorrect, and the time displayed on the left side banner (package list) menu of the shop is the correct one.

[b][Added on 03/07 (Fri) 06:30 (UTC)][b]
- Issue where the red dot notification is displayed in the ‘mission progress’ reward icon even when all unlocked missions for the ‘King Arthur 100-Day Celebration Preparations Event’ have been completed.
* The additional reward for completing all missions can be claimed once all missions from all 7 days have been completed.
- Issue where the period of the ‘King Arthur 100-Day Celebration Event’ is displayed incorrectly.
 
[b](5) Item & Rates Changes[/b]
 
The appearance list (hero, relic and/or item list) and rates of the certain items have been updated due to the inclusion of of ‘Gilroy’ and ‘Gilroy Relics’

* The published rates are rounded up according to the Enforcement Decree of the Game Industry Promotion Act and may not add up to 100%.
 
Check out the following for more details!
[url=https://forum.netmarble.com/kingarthur/view/47/2443][b]🔗 [Maintenance and Patch Details Notice][/b][/url]
[url=https://guide.netmarble.com/kingarthur][b]🔗 [Rate Info Guide][/b][/url]

Thank you.

notes.title: Official Web Shop Opening
notes.notes:
[b]Answer the call of legend and pierce through the darkness in Britain!
Welcome to ‘King Arthur: Legends Rise’.[/b]

It is with great joy that we announce the grand opening of <King Arthur: Legends Rise> Official Web Shop! ✨

We’ll guide you through how to use the shop, how to earn King Points, and everything you need to know about our Web Shop.

Check below for more details.


[h1]👑 <King Arthur: Legends Rise> Official Web Shop Opening[/h1]

[b]■ What is the Official Web Shop?[/b]
- The Web Shop is an online store where you can easily make purchases anytime, anywhere.
The shop is available on all platforms such as PC, mobile, and Steam.
* Log in with a linked game account to make purchases.
* Purchases may be unavailable during updates, patch maintenance, or special events.


[b]■ How to access the Official Web Shop[/b]
- Click the [Official Web Shop] link on the left side menu of <King Arthur: Legends Rise> Official Forum.
[b][url=https://kingarthur-shop.netmarble.com]🔗 [<King Arthur: Legends Rise> Web Shop Link][/url][/b]
* The Web Shop may not be displayed normally on certain browsers, so we recommend using either Google Chrome or Safari to access the shop.


[b]■ Settings required to use the Web Shop on iOS[/b]
- To use the Web Shop on an iOS device, make sure to change the settings as follows:  
[Settings → Safari → General → Disable [b]‘Block Pop-ups’[/b]]


[b]■ Important Notes[/b]
* You can use the Web Shop after logging in with an account linked to <King Arthur: Legends Rise>. 
* Product prices will only be available once you log in, and will be displayed in the currency of the country you first created your game account in.
* Purchased products will be sent to the in-game mailbox of the linked account you used in the shop.
* The King Points actually credited after a purchase may differ from the ‘to be earned’ estimation displayed based on the final payment amount.
* You’ll receive 10% of your purchase as King Points in your account 14 days after the date of the purchase.
* King Points will expire after 30 days from the date you received them.
* The crediting rates, limits, usage, and expiration criteria for King Points may be subject to change depending on circumstances.


[b]■ How to earn King Points[/b]
1. Go to  <King Arthur: Legends Rise> Web Shop.
2. Select your desired item and proceed to the payment screen.
3. [b]10% of the final purchase[/b] will be credited as [b]King Points after 14 days from [/b] the date of the purchase
* Applicable rates may be subject to change.
* Items already available in the game may not be available through the Web Shop.


[b]■ How to use King Points[/b]
- King Points can be used in the Web Shop just like cash, applying proportional discounts to your purchase.
- More detailed information on King Points can be found in [Profile > Points > Check Point History] at the top right corner of the Web Shop page.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43829190/d608ab6b7196b4dbe567c7b39e9ff5b6d8d4a9af.png[/img]
* A minimum of 10 King Points is required to make purchases.
* When using a combination of King Points and another payment method, a minimum cash payment requirement may be applied depending on the currency.
[b]⚠  Payments made with King Points will not earn you additional points.[/b]
Ex. 1) Full payment with King Points → [b]No points earned[/b]
Ex. 2) Payment with a combination of King Points and another payment method → Only the amount paid with another payment method will earn you points.


[b]■ Important Notes on King Points
⚠  King Points can only be earned or used when making payments through <King Arthur: Legends Rise> Web Shop or the Netmarble Launcher(PC).[/b]
* King Points can be earned and used on each account individually, and there are no limits to the amount of points you can earn.  
* It is not possible to transfer or refund points to another account.
* Points will be distributed 14 days after the date of the purchase, with potential delays of up to 1 hour.

[b]⚠ The base rate for crediting King Points is ‘10% of the purchase amount’. [/b]
* King Points will not be credited to your account if you cancel your purchase before the point distribution date.  
* King Points will not be credited to your account if you purchase products using King Points or buy items that are not eligible for credits.  
* When using a combination of King Points and another payment method, a minimum cash payment may be required depending on the currency.

[b]⚠ King Points can be used at a 1:1 ratio with the local currency. [/b]
* A minimum of 10 King Points is required to make purchases.
* If you make a payment with a combination of King Points and another payment method, only the amount paid with another payment method will earn you points.

[b]⚠ King Points will expire after 30 days from the date you received them.[/b]
* Expired King Points are deleted automatically and cannot be recovered.
* If you withdraw from or delete your <King Arthur: Legends Rise> account, every King Points you’ve earned will expire and cannot be recovered.
* Starting 30 days after being earned, King Points will expire every hour at the 30-minute mark.
* The crediting and expiration of King Points are processed on an hourly basis. Credit occurs every hour at the exact hour mark from the time of payment, while expiration occurs at the 30-minute mark of each hour from the time of payment.

[b]⚠ Points with the closest expiration date will be used first when making a payment with King Points.[/b]

[b]⚠ The crediting rate, limit, usage, and expiration criteria of King Points may be subject to change depending on circumstances.[/b]


We hope the information above helps you use the Web Shop comfortably.

Thank you.
